description: Presidential Secretariat - Declare the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Services as Essential Public Services
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It constitutes a regulatory/legal action by the President, creating a legal framework that designates specific services (in this case, those of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority) as essential public services. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers and the creation of legal obligations rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
